{{Top|leg}}
'''Bubble tents''' were survival [[Tent/Legends|tents]] used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[aquatic assault stormtrooper]]s. Kept in their [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belts]], the bubble tent could be inflated and filled with compressed air to allow the seatrooper to use it underwater.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
